title: Crowned by His Tender Surgeon
description: Clara, a dedicated surgeon constantly judged by her family for prioritizing her medical career over marriage, crosses paths with Adrien Westwood, a cold royal CEO. After saving lives and overcoming family opposition, dangerous sabotage, and personal doubts, she earns his deep devotion while staying true to her calling as a life-saving doctor.
